questions.question: Determine whether 62932451 is divisible by 139 using the Vedic method of osculators
questions.solution_html:
• Determine whether 62932451 is divisible by 139 using the Vedic method of osculators [(U)]
  • • Ekadhika of 139 is 14 (4 marks)
  • • (1× 14) + 5≡ 19 mod 139 (2 marks)
  • • (19× 14) + 4≡ 131 mod 139 [. (5 mark)
  • • (131× 14) + 2≡ 29 mod 139 [. (5 mark)
  • • (29× 14) + 3≡ 131 mod 139 [. (5 mark)
  • • (131× 14) + 9≡ 36 mod 139 [. (5 mark)
  • • (36× 14) + 2≡ 89 mod 139 [. (5 mark)
  • • (89× 14) + 6≡ 1 mod 139 [. (5 mark)
  • • Thus, 62932451 is not divisible by 139 (1 mark)
